description: Check if a blog URL slug is available or already in use.

blogId.description: Blog ID to exclude from the check (for updates)

locationId.description: Location ID to check the slug within

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

postId.description: Post ID to exclude from the check (for updates)

urlSlug.description: The URL slug to check for availability
